_readme: Our own heads and parts (not a game), described as a game so that the core names none of them: Maelys (house character), Orpheya (head made from an image, Keijo) and the clothes built in the workshop. Their files are in the data ({data}), not in the repository. The material names (内裤, 针织…) are those of the common language of the parts (see tools/games/README.md).

_fr_ok.Maëlys: the house character's name, shown as written
_fr_ok.{data}/face-library/essais/maelys/coupe-: research folders of the owner's data, not renamed by the format-2 migration
_fr_ok.{data}/essais/orpheya/image-3/result.pmx: same: research folder of the owner's data
_fr_ok.{data}/clothes/tenue-maelys-2/result.pmx: same: folder of a built outfit in the owner's data

title: Homemade

heads._note: Heads computed separately (no folder in the face library): pmx = the measured model, name = displayed name.

catalog._note: Offered by Chimera before those of the active game; small: the trial level of catalog.py prepare --level small.
